source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Fill out the reporting form.
3. Complete all the required fields.
4. Record date, time, and location of the incident.
5. Note the type of accident or injury.
6. Introduce full details of the incident - how it happened, including any sequence of events leading up to the accident.
7. Attach witness statements, if available.
8. Provide details about the injuries sustained, including a description, severity, and any medical attention required.
9. Describle the immediate response taken following the accident.
10. Note any equipment or materials involved in the accident.
11. Identify safety procedures or equipment that failed or might have contributed to the incident.
12. Include names, job titles, and department of all involved individuals.
13. Avoid personal opinions or speculation about the incident; stick to factual details.
14. Collect photographs of the scene if possible, but ensure that privacy considerations and legal limitations are respected.
